method: Playwright MCP; headed Chromium; 1 app/tab; actual keyboard WASD; 20 x 30-second active probes per variant; GC outside probes

limitations: One run per variant in sequence BVH/Rapier/Ammo; cache not controlled
Knock Hall with 24 collision triangles; does not replace Sunnyvale terrain/stair testing

Background/tab-return and mobile device tests separate
Ammo wall-clock includes additional gaps between probes; pooled p95 uses probe intervals only
